item.title: Sudan: Air attack destroys food aid for families in South Kordofan
item.description: Two truckloads of food aid destined for hungry families in South Kordofan state, Sudan, were destroyed in an aerial attack over the weekend, the World Food Progamme (WFP) said on Wednesday.

item.title: ‘Fight for humanity’: Avoiding a climate catastrophe means acting now
item.description: Record heat waves, deadly flooding and extreme weather reflect an ever-warming planet poised to soon breach safe temperature limits, according to a UN report released on Tuesday, but doubling down on climate action now could avoid a climate catastrophe.

item.title: ‘Don’t give up’: Syrian women’s ongoing search for the missing
item.description: Yasmin Al-Mashaan lost five brothers during more than a decade of conflict in Syria. Two were forcibly disappeared. Three were killed during peaceful demonstrations or by snipers loyal to the Bashar Al-Assad regime.

item.title: Repression of political opposition surges in post-election Zambia
item.description: Following Zambia’s contested presidential and parliamentary elections almost three weeks ago, the crackdown on political opposition has intensified, raising concerns about the future of democracy in the country, according to a UN Human Rights Council-appointed expert.

item.title: World News in Brief: US-Iran war intensifies, aid for Myanmar, casualties in Ukraine
item.description: Fighting between the United States and Iran has sharply escalated after a month-long lull, with the two sides exchanging strikes as fears grow over further civilian casualties.
